$comment: City configuration — SPEC.md §15.
This file is the ONLY source of the data specific to a conurbation.
No URL, coordinate or network name may appear anywhere else in the code.
The 'boundingBox' block is RECOMPUTED automatically by tools/compute_bbox.py
on every regeneration of the data (§4) — do not edit it by hand.
To carry the application over to another city, copy this file and adjust only
'network', 'gbfsDiscoveryUrl', 'map' and 'dataRelease'. See README.md.
What the network lends, counted from its own feeds (§4.1).
Never written by hand, and never taken from the vehicle_types
declaration alone: a third of the networks declaring a mixed fleet
have not a single bike of one of the two kinds in circulation.
tools/read_fleet.py therefore counts the bikes actually available
at the stations, and writes what it saw.
"electricBikes" marks every bike glyph drawn for this city with a
bolt (§7); "mixed" is what allows the station sheet to split its
count into mechanical and electric; "vehicleTypes" translates the
identifiers the status feed counts by into the two kinds.
A network whose feeds let nothing be counted keeps whatever its
declaration says and is never called mixed: the application draws
one plain figure rather than a split nobody verified.
URL of the auto-discovery file, and of that alone (§4.1).
Taken from the MobilityData catalogue, then verified by a real request

$comment: Reference box shared by the three datasets (§4).
Derived from the stations' enclosing rectangle, widened by 3 km.
Generated by tools/compute_bbox.py — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
Opening centre and zoom, used when no position is available.
MapLibre counts in 512-pixel tiles: its zoom is off by about one step
from the 256-tile convention. Zoom 11.2 frames the whole conurbation
there.
What tools/generate_all.sh needs in order to produce this
city's data in one command: the OpenStreetMap extract to cut
the box out of, and the Base Adresse Nationale departments the
box reaches. Both are read from the stations themselves, not
from an administrative boundary — a network routinely spills
into a neighbouring department.
Default URL of the manifest describing the published dataset (§4.4).
Changeable in the settings, and bypassable by manual import: the host
must never be a single point of failure.
formatVersion 2: the address index now carries the names of absorbed
municipalities (Lomme, Hellemmes…), without which their inhabitants
